# gramlot-js-server 0.3.27

Aligns the JavaScript server, serverless exporter and project generator with Gramlot 0.3.27. The file-origin collection bridge derives each module interface from the installed public runtime exports, so Grid collections can use the shared TYTX codec without duplicating it.

The documented WebKit file-origin uploader limitation remains. Invoice application and Python compiled-page export remain excluded.
